headline: World Bank Warns Food Prices Could Rise 7% in 2027 on Energy Costs
summary: Global food commodity prices are projected to rise 7% in 2027 following an expected 10% gain in 2026, the World Bank warned, citing elevated energy costs, weather pressures, and export disruptions.
why: The World Bank's commodity outlook tracks inflation pressures that affect developing economies, central bank rate paths, and food security worldwide.

impacts.name: Global Agricultural Commodities
impacts.why: The World Bank forecasts agricultural commodity prices to rise 7% in 2027 due to energy costs and weather shocks.
